manifest.name: AKS Stale Doc Reviews
manifest.description: Review AKS documentation for stale commands, versions, screenshots, and unsupported guidance before refresh planning.
manifest.author: Squadboard team

project.name: AKS Stale Doc Reviews
project.description: A private AKS documentation freshness review workflow.

team.name: aks-doc-auditor
team.charter:
# aks-doc-auditor

Reviews AKS docs for stale commands, screenshots, dates, and unsupported guidance. Separates customer-impacting staleness from editorial cleanup.

team.name: aks-command-validator
team.charter:
# aks-command-validator

Checks Azure CLI, kubectl, and Kubernetes version references for current AKS behavior. Requests live validation evidence for risky changes.

team.name: aks-pm-reviewer
team.charter:
# aks-pm-reviewer

Prioritizes stale-doc findings by customer impact, support burden, preview/GA status, and release timing.

ceremonies.name: AKS Stale Doc Review
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: AKS Stale Doc Review
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: Staleness audit
    agent: aks-doc-auditor
    prompt: "Review this AKS doc for stale commands, versions, screenshots, screenshots references, and unsupported guidance."
    timeout: 25m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Command validation
    agent: aks-command-validator
    prompt: "Validate CLI and kubectl guidance for current AKS behavior and list commands needing live verification."
    timeout: 25m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Customer-impact priority
    agent: aks-pm-reviewer
    prompt: "Prioritize findings by customer impact, support burden, and release timing."
    timeout: 20m

skills.name: AKS Stale Documentation Review
skills.description: Audit AKS docs for stale technical guidance and prioritize remediation.
